notes.title: Sept. 15 2024 Update
notes.content: Version 2.2.3 now supports older Direct Input controllers.

notes.title: August 31, 2024 update
notes.content: In addition to all of the previous changes to the emulation wrapper (improved audio performance, having to hold down Escape, Pause/Break, or Home keys for 1.5 seconds for them to take effect), fixed a minor bug in which the aspect ratio on the settings screen was not being displayed properly under some circumstances.
